caveats: The gateway returns the nearest model land grid cell, recorded explicitly in cloud-climatology.csv.
Cloud percentages are instantaneous grid-area fractions, not the probability that a particular sightline is clear.
The low/mid/high layer values overlap vertically and do not sum to total cloud cover.
Climatology ranks regimes; it is not a forecast for 12 August 2026.

forecast_snapshot.reason: The target was about fourteen days away; deterministic detail is unstable and the ECMWF 51-member ensemble did not yet expose the exact 18:00 UTC step.
forecast_snapshot.layer_definition_difference: The forecast gateway uses low below 3 km, mid 3-8 km and high above 8 km; these are not the CERRA climatology layer boundaries.
